acceptanceCriteria: tests reports each test-looking file that no configured runner selects under its default configuration as TEST-FILE-UNSELECTED with a reason: no-runner-for-framework, outside-include, excluded (naming the pattern), suffix-mismatch.
Inventory and crosswalk producers carry the flag, and witness/coverage credit refuses flagged files.

Selected files are not reported; runner configs the reader cannot parse abstain rather than report; requirements in the owning test-selection spec; focused tests via heavy.sh; dogfood CEM; build-log entry; Closes #1172.
body: GitHub #1172. Files that look like tests (framework imports, test-definition calls, directory convention) but no configured runner selects (no runner for the framework, outside include globs, explicitly excluded, suffix mismatch) look like coverage in inventories/crosswalks and get cited as evidence though they never run.
title: GH #1172: tests: report test files no configured runner selects (TEST-FILE-UNSELECTED) and keep them out of witness credit
